scope: One anonymous read-only production MediaWiki parse of the complete final source at its technical documentation title. The earlier local missing-SyntaxHighlight attempt remains preserved as an infrastructure limitation, without repeating it.
nativePresentationExplanation: Two native SyntaxHighlight blocks display a nonbreaking space before a table separator.
